description: An organic acid naturally present in citrus fruits, manufactured commercially through fermentation.
purpose: Controls acidity, adds a tart or sour flavour, and acts as an antioxidant synergist.

description: A mineral salt that decomposes upon heating or reaction with acids to release carbon dioxide gas.
purpose: Leavens baked foods by creating carbon dioxide bubbles that cause dough or batter to expand.

description: An inorganic chemical compound used in low-moisture baking that leaves no moisture residue.
purpose: Releases carbon dioxide and ammonia gas during baking to produce a crisp texture in biscuits and crackers.

description: A fatty substance naturally found in egg yolks and soybeans.
purpose: Prevents oil and water from separating, aids ingredient blending, and reduces viscosity in chocolate.

names: mono- and di-glycerides of fatty acids
description: Lipids composed of glycerol combined with one or two fatty acids derived from edible plant oils or animal fats.
purpose: Helps blend oil and water, improves crumb softness in baked goods, and stabilizes aeration.

description: An emulsifier produced by esterifying polyglycerol with condensed castor oil fatty acids.
purpose: Reduces yield value and friction in liquid chocolate, allowing smooth coating and mould flow.

description: A dark brown colour manufactured by heat treating carbohydrates in the presence of sulfite and ammonium compounds.
purpose: Imparts deep brown colour and acid stability to carbonated beverages and baked products.

description: A mineral inorganic acid produced from phosphorus rock minerals.
purpose: Provides a distinctive sharp and tangy taste in cola soft drinks and checks mold development.

description: The sodium salt of the non-essential amino acid glutamic acid, produced industrially by bacterial fermentation.
purpose: Stimulates savory umami taste receptors to deepen and round savory flavours in snacks and seasonings.

description: A natural nucleotide sodium salt usually produced from tapioca starch fermentation.
purpose: Acts synergistically with glutamates to boost umami perception at very low concentrations.

description: A sodium salt of inosinic acid obtained from fermented sugar or animal tissues.
purpose: Works in tandem with monosodium glutamate to amplify savoury meat and broth flavours.

description: The sodium salt of benzoic acid, synthesized for commercial food preservation.
purpose: Inhibits growth of yeasts, bacteria, and molds in acidic conditions such as sauces, juices, and dressings.

description: A potassium salt of the naturally occurring polyunsaturated fatty acid sorbic acid.
purpose: Prevents mold and yeast proliferation across a broad range of cheeses, baked goods, and syrups.

description: An inorganic sulfur-containing salt that releases sulfur dioxide in moist acidic environments.
purpose: Weakens gluten matrix to relax dough elasticity in biscuit rolling and retards enzymatic browning.

description: An organic carboxylic acid produced via fermentation of ethanol by acetic acid bacteria.
purpose: Provides distinct pungent sourness, balances flavours, and lowers pH to preserve pickles and sauces.

description: A dicarboxylic organic acid naturally found in unripe apples and grapes.
purpose: Imparts a persistent, smooth tartness and enhances fruit flavour notes in beverages and candies.

description: A white crystalline organic acid occurring naturally in tamarind, wine grapes, and bananas.
purpose: Gives a strong, immediate sour bite and activates chemical leavening agents in baking powders.

description: A naturally occurring metal halide mineral salt composed of potassium and chlorine.
purpose: Promotes starch gelatinization in instant noodles and provides mineral balance in food matrices.

description: An alkaline inorganic potassium salt historically termed potash.
purpose: Acts as an alkaline agent (kansui component) to develop the firm, springy texture and yellow hue in ramen noodles.

description: A water-soluble inorganic sodium salt of carbonic acid.
purpose: Adjusts alkalinity during noodle making to enhance gluten network formation and moisture binding.

description: A polyphosphate salt formed by condensing sodium phosphates.
purpose: Retains moisture content, tenderizes noodle strands, and binds metal ions to preserve texture.

description: An amorphous silicon and oxygen oxide mineral found naturally in quartz and plant structures.
purpose: Adsorbs moisture from powdered foods to prevent clumps and maintain free-flowing seasoning powders.

description: A galactomannan polysaccharide extracted from the seeds of the drought-hardy guar plant.
purpose: Thickens liquids without heating, creates smooth mouthfeel, and stabilizes emulsions in sauces.

description: A high molecular weight polysaccharide produced by the fermentation of carbohydrates by Xanthomonas campestris.
purpose: Provides pseudoplastic viscosity, holding spices and solids in suspension without altering flavor.

description: Corn, potato, or tapioca starch treated chemically with acetic anhydride and adipic anhydride.
purpose: Resists high-temperature cooking, acid breakdown, and freeze-thaw cycles in canned foods and sauces.

description: A complex mixture of ammonium salts of phosphatidic acids synthesized from edible fats.
purpose: Alternative chocolate emulsifier that regulates flow characteristics during confection enrobing.

description: A synthetic azo dye that provides a bright lemon-yellow coloration.
purpose: Restores or adds yellow coloration to confectioneries, snack coatings, and powdered beverages.

description: A synthetic petroleum-derived orange azo dye.
purpose: Produces an orange-yellow hue in snack seasonings, cheese curls, and fruit-flavoured drinks.

description: A synthetic red azo dye manufactured for heat and light stability.
purpose: Imparts bright red colouring to gelatins, soft drinks, and spicy snack seasonings.

description: A synthetic triarylmethane dye that produces a clear blue shade.
purpose: Provides vibrant blue coloration or blends with yellow colours to create shades of green.

description: A carotenoid-based natural food dye extracted from the seeds of the achiote tree.
purpose: Imparts yellow to golden-orange hues to table butter, cheeses, and extruded snacks.

description: A water-soluble vitamin and organic acid identical to natural Vitamin C.
purpose: Acts as an oxygen scavenger to prevent fruit browning and aids dough strength in breadmaking.

description: Fat-soluble phenolic compounds extracted from vegetable oils, functioning identically to Vitamin E.
purpose: Retards rancidity and lipid oxidation in edible vegetable oils and fried snack foods.

description: A zero-calorie artificial sweetener synthesized by selective chlorination of sucrose.
purpose: Provides sweetness approximately 600 times stronger than sugar without contributing caloric bulk.

description: A calorie-free potassium salt of an organic acid with high thermal stability.
purpose: Sweetens calorie-reduced beverages and combines with sucralose to mask bitter aftertastes.

description: A disaccharide composed of glucose and fructose derived from sugar cane or sugar beet.
purpose: Provides sweet taste, builds texture and solids in baked products, and binds moisture.

description: Crystalline sodium chloride mineral fortified with potassium iodate.
purpose: Enhances food flavour profiles, controls microbial growth, and supplies dietary iodine.

description: Finely milled and sieved endosperm of wheat grain with bran and germ separated.
purpose: Serves as the structural cereal base providing starch and gluten proteins for bakery goods.

description: An edible vegetable oil naturally balanced in saturated and unsaturated fatty acids extracted from oil palm pulp.
purpose: Provides frying stability at high temperatures and gives crispness and shelf life to snacks.

description: A moderately sweet polysaccharide derived through controlled enzymatic hydrolysis of plant starch.
purpose: Acts as a carrier for spray-dried seasoning flavours, builds body, and improves solubility.
